Class RemoteRcx

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.rcx.RemoteRcx
public final class RemoteRcx extends Object
A LEGO Mindstorms RCX brick reached over infrared, in the manner of LeJOS's RemoteNXT: create it once, at startup, with the infrared RcxLink and the pins of the IR receiver module and the IR LED, call begin(), and get the brick's parts from it — its motors (getMotorA(), getMotorB(), getMotorC()), its sensor inputs (getSensor1(), getSensor2(), getSensor3()), its display (getLcd()), its speaker (getAudio()), its batteries (getBattery()) and its firmware loader (getFirmware()). Every part shares one RcxLink, so the brick sees one toggle bit, and is allocated here, so getting one allocates nothing. The display commands need Juno's own RCX firmware (RcxRemoteFirmware); the rest also works with LEGO's.

It also speaks as the RCX Remote Control (9709) does: buttons() decodes the remote's button state and sendButtons(int) transmits it, so the brick in remote-control mode drives its motors with no firmware commands at all, and message() and sendMessage(int) carry RCX message values. It is plain Java on top of Infrared, which carries the 2400 baud bytes; see there for the wiring.

Every message is 55 FF 00 followed by each byte and its complement: the opcode, its arguments and a checksum. The remote sends opcode 0xD2 with a 16-bit button mask, repeatedly while a button is held and once more with the mask 0 on release.

The mask goes on the wire high byte first (D2 hh ll); the button constants below use the decoded 16-bit mask order.

Receiving and sending are blocking: a frame takes about 50 ms at 2400 baud, during which buttons() (or message()) decodes it. Call them regularly from the main loop, not while Delay.millis is waiting. Works on both boards.

      public int buttons()
      The buttons currently held on the remote as a mask of the button constants, or 0 when none is held. Decodes a frame if one is arriving; the last state is kept for 300 ms and then counts as released, in case the release message was missed.
